gameDescriptionHtml:
Two PlayStation 1 classics return: Fighting Force and Fighting Force 2!

Fighting Force: Originally released in 1997, this beat ’em up classic let players become Hawk Manson, Mace Daniels, Alana McKendricks, or Ben “Smasher” Johnson as they fight to take down the evil Dr. Dex Zeng.

Fighting Force 2: This follow-up released in 1999 – in this game, players take the role of Hawk Manson, who is covertly investigating human cloning experiments by the Knackmiche Corporation.

Game Features

  • (Fighting Force) Choose from two male or two female characters, each with different skills and strengths.
  • (Fighting Force) Play alone or in co-op mode to defeat your enemies.
  • (Fighting Force) Dozens of moves per character.
  • (Fighting Force) Seven action packed levels in 22 different stages.
  • (Fighting Force) Pick up weapons like rocket launchers, shotguns, pipes, guns, grenades and more!
  • (Fighting Force 2) Negotiate through complex R&D facilities featuring amazing visuals and advanced special effects.
  • (Fighting Force 2) Fierce hand-to-hand combat including deadly combination moves.
  • (Fighting Force 2) Use an arsenal of over 20 lethal weapons to assist in removal of key personnel and complete destruction of environments.
